editions.course: Zach’s to Butterfield Park to Adam’s. 3.3 miles.
editions.notes: Rain or shine. Trophies for first, last, most clothed, least clothed, and Candy Cane Collectors. Finished at a hot tub.
quotes: Come one and all to the first (annual?) Freezing Cold 5K!!

editions.course: Zach’s to Butterfield Park to Adam’s
editions.notes: Hot tub confirmed to be hot.

editions.course: Reversed for fire pit logistics: Adam’s to Butterfield Park to Zach’s
editions.notes: Outdoors, distanced, masked. Masks turn out to be convenient below freezing.
quotes: I think it is still reasonable to uphold this sacred, three-year-old tradition.

editions.course: Adam’s to Butterfield Park to Zach’s
editions.notes: Hot tub afterwards. Bring a bathing suit.

editions.course: Zach’s to Butterfield Park and back
editions.notes: First shirts: the FC5K V long sleeve. First year on Partiful.
quotes: We run the FC5K because the weather tells us not to. Because our bodies fight it with every cell. Because together we overcome, together we run.

editions.course: Zach’s to Butterfield Park and back
quotes: Holy crap we made it to six.

editions.notes: Snacks and hot chocolate at 3. Pizza after.
quotes: Here we are again. Can you believe it?

editions.course: Zach’s to Jack’s to Kayla’s and back
quotes: Be prepared. Be cold. Be fast. Be merry. Be there.
